topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: I understand how tough this must be for you, more than you think. It’s important to face these situations head-on, but not alone. I believe in you, and we can work through this together. Take your time to review the evidence, and let’s figure out the best way to address the concerns. Remember, your integrity and efforts are valuable, and it’s okay to feel overwhelmed. Just remember, you’re not alone in this. We’ll sort this out, step by step, and come out stronger on the other side. Keep your head up, and let’s do this.
